setupNotes: Change type: field requirement revert on a live workflow. No routing, assignment, decision-branch, form, external-operation or permission change is in scope; anything else found in the YAML comparison is out of scope until the owner confirms it.

Do NOT import the previous YAML as a new workflow to 'restore history'. An import creates a new draft lineage (new workflow, version 1, new auto-number counter, no forms, no Form Fill links, creator-only access unless an access section is present) and leaves the six open cases on the old workflow. Create a new draft version of the live workflow instead and reapply the previous field requirements to it.

Before building the draft: export the active version (workflow_export_yaml in connected mode, or the UI export) to workflow.current.yaml and place the previous YAML at workflow.previous.yaml next to this manifest; the semantic comparison in change-plan.md is pending until both exist.
Impact check on the six open incidents is PENDING: their records were unavailable. Obtain the export described in source incidents-open before publication.

Form Fill definitions are frozen with the workflow publication; the trigger (intake) form publishes independently. After the new version is published, re-check every form that maps to a field whose required flag changed.
Publication, cancellation of cases and any deletion are UI actions by an authorized person; nothing in this plan is applied by the plugin.
Connected mode: the host offered org_get_context but the call was not authorized in this session; organization.mode stays disconnected and no tenant ids were read.

decisions.question: Which workflow is affected? Provide its name (and id, if known) and the active version number so the live export can be pinned.

Accept that a YAML re-import cannot restore version history and approve the versioned recovery instead: a new draft version of the live workflow that reapplies the previous field requirements (roll-forward), published as the next version.

Supply the previous YAML and the current live export so the field-by-field comparison can list exactly which required flags change, and in which direction (required -> optional, or optional -> required).

Supply the export of the six open incidents (id, version, current action, status, values of the changed fields, Form Fill responses). Until then the impact check is pending and publication should wait.

How should the six open cases be handled: (a) finish on their current version after the test T2/T3 result confirms they can complete; (b) have the assignee fill the now-missing values before publication; (c) cancel and recreate on the new version (last resort, loses evidence and history)?

Confirm the live workflow's current grants and manual-trigger allowlist (workflow_get with includeAccess, or the UI) so the manifest placeholder 'creator_only' is replaced by the real access and nothing is narrowed or widened by the new version.
Effective date and communication: when will the new version be published, and who informs the requesters and assignees of the six open cases and of new cases that the required fields changed back?
